name: DocHub
summary: Online PDF editor and e-signature tool: edit text and fields in a PDF, sign it yourself and send sign requests, with a free plan capped at a few uses a month.
best_for: freelancers and small teams who fill in and sign their own PDFs in the browser, and who will pay for Pro once they send many documents for other people to sign
skip_if: you send several documents a month for others to sign and want that on a free plan, or you will not put a card down to try Pro
honest_knock: The free plan's 3 uses a month are shared by editing, self-signing and sign requests, and our test could not show which actions counted. Unlimited sign requests need Pro, whose trial asks for a card and becomes a €16 monthly charge after 30 days unless you cancel.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month, Basic billed yearly, before tax, as the page showed it from a European connection
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-18 on dochub.com/pricing in a browser and in our own test the same day; from our European connection the page showed euros, and prices are before tax) DocHub has four plans. Free costs €0. Its core features, which are editing existing text, self sign, sending sign requests, templates, envelopes and sharing by link, all draw on one limit of 3 uses a month, next to basic PDF tools, the AI Assistant and the mobile apps; the comparison table also caps Free at 3 folders. Basic is €8 a month billed yearly or €11 billed monthly. It makes self sign, PDF downloads, templates and folders unlimited and adds advanced fillable fields and document attachments, but editing existing text, sign requests and envelopes stay inside the limit of 3 uses a month. Pro is €12 a month billed yearly or €16 billed monthly and makes PDF editing, sign requests and envelopes unlimited, with bulk send, in-person signing and the DocHub Intelligence tools on top. Site License is priced through sales and adds unlimited users, single sign-on, and HIPAA with a BAA available. The yearly switch says it saves 25%, and in an organization each member who needs Pro features is paid for. Pro has a 30-day free trial. At checkout on 18 November 2026 it asked for a card through Stripe and said the first payment of €16.00 would be due on 18 December 2026, plus taxes, unless the trial is cancelled before that date; the yearly Pro checkout showed €12 a month billed as €144 a year. We could not read US dollar prices.

compare_with.name: SignThis
compare_with.why: SignThis is in our directory as a tested e-signature tool whose free plan counts only sent documents, 3 a month with several signers each. DocHub adds PDF editing next to signing, but on its free plan edits, signatures and sign requests share one limit of 3. Pick by whether you mostly edit and sign yourself or mostly send

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested DocHub on the free plan, a day after our first test. Editing and self-signing a test PDF took about 1 min 35 s. The new free plan meter showed that only the self-signature counted against the 3 uses a month. The Pro trial checkout now preselects yearly billing at EUR144.00 and asks for a card first. Account and start: we created the account on the free plan; our AI assistant ran this second test in its own tab on 19 November 2026 from 12:34 CET, with the interface in English. It follows the test of 18 November and adds the free plan meter, sharing and sign requests, export options, the cancel route and account deletion. Core action, edit and sign a PDF: a one-page test agreement with no personal data was uploaded and showed Ready. The A tool added text next to the amount as a new text box, not as an edit of the existing text, and saved automatically. A comment appeared as a note icon and a sidebar card. Sign, Create your signature offers Phone, Draw, Upload Image and Type, with the line Signatures you create with DocHub are legally valid. A typed test signature saved with Signature Saved! and was placed on the page. Upload to signed document took about 1 min 35 s and about 14 steps. Sharing: Share with others offers Send as Attachment, Send Sign Request and Get Shareable Link, and adding collaborators by email; nothing was filled in. Send Sign Request has automated reminders, expiry and webhook options, while signer sign-in, signer locations and document ID are locked. After Add Signer it says Assign at least one field to this user or enable annotations, so a field must be assigned first. Nothing was sent. Export: Download or export offers PDF, or DOCX behind a lock, the Document or its Audit Trail, and PDF options behind a lock. One plain PDF was downloaded; it held the added text, the typed signature and the comment icon, with no watermark seen, and was then deleted. Limits: after the download a Free Plan Limits meter showed 1 of 3 DocHub core features used, with 1 used on Basic features (Self Sign, Templates, Share via Link) and 0 used on Pro features (Edit Text, Send Sign Request, Envelopes). So the self-signature counted, and the added text, upload and comment did not. Plans: billed yearly, Free EUR 0, Basic EUR 8 and Pro EUR 12 a month, Site License on request; billed monthly, Basic 11 and Pro 16. The comparison table lists Audit Trail on every plan, Send for Signature only on Pro. Checkout, seen up to the card: Pro Try for Free opened a checkout with yearly billing preselected: This subscription is free for 30 days then your first payment of EUR144.00 will be due on December 19, 2026. Taxes will apply. It asks for card number, expiry, security code and country through Stripe before the trial starts. Nothing was filled in and the trial was not started. Billing shows Plan Free and No payment methods. Cancelling: no trial was started, so nothing was cancelled. The FAQ names Settings, Billing, Change Plan, Cancel Subscription. Account deletion sits under Settings, Account, Danger Zone, Delete Account; not clicked. Not tested: sending a sign request and what a signer sees, downloading the audit trail, the Pro trial and its cancellation, DOCX export and cloud exports. Clean up: the account with two test documents and a saved test signature stays; the downloaded file was deleted. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Adding text next to existing text makes a new text box that sits against the old text. A sign request cannot be sent until a field is assigned to the signer. The Pro checkout preselects yearly billing.

sessions.what: We created the accounts and our AI assistant ran the tests in our browser. On 21 November 2026 we ran a third session on a fresh free account: we imported our own one page test PDF, added fields, made a template, sent a real sign request to a second inbox of ours and signed it there without a DocHub account. From Send Request to Finalized took about 3 minutes. Our sessions of 18 and 19 November covered editing, self-signing and the Pro checkout.
findings: Text we checked: "1 of 3 DocHub core features used". What we saw (19 Nov 2026): The meter counted the self-signature as 1 use (Basic features) and 0 for Pro features; the added text, the upload and the comment did not count. The dossier says our first test could not show which actions counted.

Text we checked: "This subscription is free for 30 days then your first payment of EUR144.00 will be due on December 19, 2026. Taxes will apply". What we saw (19 Nov 2026): The Pro checkout preselected yearly billing at EUR144.00, while the dossier knock says the trial becomes a EUR 16 monthly charge; monthly is still available at EUR16 a month.

Text we checked: "Assign at least one field to this user or enable annotations". What we saw (19 Nov 2026): Send Request stays disabled until the signer has a field or annotations; several options such as signer locations are locked on Free. Nothing was sent.
First test, 18 November 2026: upload to signed document took about 1 minute 47 seconds on the free plan.

Text we checked: "1 of 3 DocHub core features used". What we saw (21 Nov 2026): on a fresh free account the meter counted 1 use under Pro features (Edit Text, Send Sign Request, Envelopes) after we edited text and sent one sign request; turning a copy into a template counted 0.

Text we checked: "DocHub Core Features (3 uses/mo)" on dochub.com/pricing. What we saw (21 Nov 2026): the pricing page does not say which actions use up the 3; the app meter does, and splits them into Basic features and Pro features.

Text we checked: "EUR 450" in our own PDF. What we saw (21 Nov 2026): typing 500 over it with the text tool made a new text box and left the original figure visible; replacing it cleanly needs the whiteout tool first.

Text we checked: "ACTION NEEDED: test-agreement.pdf". What we saw (21 Nov 2026): the sign request reached our second inbox within seconds, and the signer could sign with a typed name without creating an account; Send Request to Finalized took about 3 minutes. Opening the signer link in the same browser signed us out of the sender account.

Text we checked: "Radio Button, Dropdown, Image, Attachment". What we saw (21 Nov 2026): these field types carry a Pro lock on the free plan; text, date, checkbox, initials and signature fields are free.
not_tested: The audit trail: after signing in the same browser the sender account was signed out, so we could not open it; the exported PDF of our signed test had no audit page.
The Pro trial and its cancellation.
